title: Entryway hero and step-stitching: interactive above-fold assets for Quickstart landing
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, high-impact above-the-fold hero and a connected step-stitching diagram for the Quickstart landing page that communicates the product value (hosted, dedicated, private) and reduces time-to-first-success for new users. Scope includes: hero composition (headline, subcopy, CTA), interactive device mock switcher (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), a progressive step-stitching diagram that visually links the hero to 3 starter tasks, microcopy A/B variants, motion spec (Lottie + CSS fallback), responsive breakpoints, and exported assets for engineering and docs. Constraints: keep hero payload budget small, respect reduced-motion settings, and surface analytics hooks for impressions and CTA clicks.
tasks: Audit existing quickstart assets and competitor hero patterns
Define hero information hierarchy and microcopy variants (A/B) for testing
Create 3 low-fidelity hero layouts with alternative device switcher patterns
Iterate in Figma with PM and Eng; refine to a single high-fidelity direction
Produce motion spec: Lottie animation + CSS micro-interactions + fallback PNGs
Build reusable Figma components (device mock, step-stitch connector, CTA) with tokens
Export production-ready assets (SVGs, optimized Lottie JSON, 1x/2x screenshots, WebP) and naming guide
Write implementation handoff doc for frontend: bundle budget, lazy-load hooks, aria pattern
QA screenshots across breakpoints and write verification checklist for docs
Collect sign-off from PM, Engineering, and Accessibility lead
acceptance_criteria: Hero comp is approved by PM and Design and exists as a single Figma page with documented components
Interactive device switcher implemented with a lightweight Lottie (or CSS) animation <= 150KB compressed, with image fallback
Step-stitching diagram maps to three documented starter tasks and exposes data attributes for analytics
All hero and diagram assets exported and uploaded to Drive with naming conventions and 1x/2x retina variants
Responsive behavior verified at breakpoints: 360px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px with screenshots
Reduced-motion preference respected (animations disabled or simplified) and contrast ratio meets AA for hero text
Implementation spec includes lazy-load & intersection observer guidance and PR checklist items
Microcopy variant A/B saved and recommended variant flagged for rollout based on qualitative PM feedback
